description: This file implements distributed tensor matrix operations and strategies for various matrix-related ops in a distributed setting, including sharding strategies, strategy generation for einsum, and specific implementations for attention mechanisms and matrix multiplications.

classes.name: OpStrategy
classes.description: Represents a strategy for tensor operations, including input/output specs and costs.

classes.name: OpSpec
classes.description: Defines a specific operation strategy, including output and input specifications.

classes.name: DTensorSpec
classes.description: Specifies the shape, mesh, and placement of distributed tensors.

classes.name: TensorMeta
classes.description: Metadata about tensor shape, stride, and dtype used in local computations.

classes.name: EinsumDims
classes.description: Helper class for parsing and handling einsum equation dimensions.

methods.name: transpose_strategy
methods.description: Strategy for transposing a tensor by transposing shard placements.

methods.name: _mm_like_strategy
methods.description: Generates strategies similar to matrix multiplication for a given einsum equation.

methods.name: _addmm_like_strategy
methods.description: Generates strategies similar to addmm operation.

methods.name: _scaled_mm_like_strategy
methods.description: Generates strategies for scaled matrix multiplication.

methods.name: gen_single_dim_einsum_strategies
methods.description: Generates einsum-style strategies over device mesh dimensions.

methods.name: mm_single_dim_strategy
methods.description: Wrapper for generating single-dimension einsum strategies.

methods.name: scaled_dot_product_flash_attention_strategy
methods.description: Strategy for scaled dot product flash attention.

methods.name: scaled_dot_product_efficient_attention_strategy
methods.description: Strategy for scaled dot product efficient attention.

methods.name: scaled_scaled_dot_product_cudnn_attention_backward_strategy
methods.description: Backward strategy for scaled cuDNN attention.
